messages:
Anya: Quick design review — playground streaming UX. I noticed folks keep hitting ‘Stop’ then expect to resume. Figma link: https://fig.ma/file/streaming-ux (mock v3). Thoughts on changing verbing and adding a tiny token peek on hover?
Mike: saw it — users think Stop = pause. Maybe we need explicit Pause vs Cancel states. Pause should keep the KV cache and allow resume, Cancel should clear.
Lee: +1. We already have internal state for resumable streams in the runtime. UX needs to indicate when resume will work. Maybe use a persistent compact chip: [Streaming • 12 tokens buffered] with a resume button.
Sarah: concerned about discoverability and a11y. If we add a compact chip, it needs an accessible name and keyboard focus order. Also screen readers should announce "response paused, press Resume to continue".
Anya: agree. Copy options I'm testing:
```
Option A: Pause (keeps progress, resume available)
Option B: Stop (cancel generation)
Regenerate (start fresh)
```
Any short microcopy suggestions?
Mike: prefer verbs: Pause / Stop / Regenerate. But microcopy on hover could be: "Pause to temporarily stop and resume later". Keep the primary CTA simple.
Lee: token peek idea — small overlay when you hover a message showing token count and an estimated cost. Could be collapsed into the message toolbar. We should avoid making token count first-class for casual users though.
Sarah: for screen reader users, token info should be behind a toggle; otherwise noise. Announce only when the user opts into developer mode.
design-bot: small nit — iconography: Pause icon (two bars) + tooltip "Pause"; Stop icon (square) + tooltip "Stop". Use filled vs outline to indicate destructive action.
Anya: another UX flow question: when user hits Regenerate while paused, do we: 1) resume and regenerate from last prompt, 2) clear and start new? Current product does #2. Would folks expect #1?
Mike: I think Regenerate should always start fresh. We can add a small "Resume and continue" action for paused streams to avoid surprise.
Lee: implementation detail: when paused we keep KV cache for 5 minutes; resume checks for model/variant compatibility. If model changed, we should warn. Put a tiny banner: "Model changed — resume not possible".
Sarah: keyboard shortcuts: propose 'Space' to Pause/Resume when message pane focused, and 'R' for Regenerate with a confirmation on destructive regen. Make sure focus trap works for screen readers.
Anya: copy candidates for chip and confirmation: "Resume response" / "Start over — discard current response?" Sarah says keep confirm copy explicit.
design-bot: UX decision logged in FigJam v3 board under "Streaming controls". Tagging @Anya for final copy. :white_check_mark:
aria-bot: accessibility checklist reminder: focus order, aria-live announcements when state changes, visible focus ring on chip, keyboard shortcut documentation in Help Center.
Mike: action items: Anya finalize copy by EOD Tuesday; Lee to prototype token-peek overlay (compact); Sarah to draft a11y acceptance criteria.
Anya: great — I'll push an updated mock with Pause chip and microcopy later today. Thanks! :sparkles:
